_meta.title: Smooth motion / slow-mo (frame interpolation)
_meta.description: Core ComfyUI frame interpolation (Comfy-Org utility_video_frame_interpolation template, flattened): LoadVideo -> GetVideoComponents -> FrameInterpolationModelLoader + FrameInterpolate (multiplier x) -> CreateVideo -> SaveVideo. Smooth mode: fps = source fps x multiplier (ComfyMathExpression), same duration, source audio kept. Slow-mo mode: the builder (src/lib/oj/frameInterpolate.ts) feeds the source fps straight into CreateVideo (clip becomes multiplier x longer) and drops the audio (it would end early and drift). Models (models/frame_interpolation): rife_v4.26.safetensors (default), rife_v4.26_heavy.safetensors, film_net_fp16.safetensors. All frames are held in memory: keep clips short. A VideoTemporalCrop head cap keeps at most 960 output frames (480 source frames at 2x, 240 at 4x) so long clips cannot exhaust RAM; it trims audio with the frames.
